Vendored for the offline demo (#91). Exact versions, byte-identical to unpkg (sha384 equals the SRI pinned in
support.js): react 18.3.1 and react-dom 18.3.1 (umd/*.production.min.js), @babel/standalone 7.29.0 (babel.min.js),
all MIT (LICENSE.*). Fonts: Geist and Geist Mono (SIL OFL 1.1) from Google Fonts, the woff2 files and the CSS that
fonts.googleapis.com serves for the URL the pages used, with URLs rewritten to ./. Fetched from registry.npmjs.org
and fonts.gstatic.com on 2026-11-21.
